items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: Uh, we had another little band, Alvin Alcorn. Uh, yeah, a little seven piece band.

ctx.x: Sam was his name, and they give him a name, Hold It Sam. Yeah, I see. But when he invented that record, hold it that, that number, they give him that name, Hold It Sam. But his name was Sam, but his last name, I didn't know it. Uh, we had another little band, Alvin Alcorn. Uh, yeah, a little seven piece band. They made up. It was a wonderful little band. But, I forgot all of them, but some of them died. Yeah.
Well, the most, did a lot of them leave town, or did most of them just stay here?
